findings.detail: Three Plasma Buyer LLC one-stop positions are non-accrual; the schedule's one-stop non-accrual principal, amortized cost, and fair value tie to those rows.

rationale: The current SOI lists Plasma Buyer LLC one-stop rows at table 16 rows 40-42 with principal 501, 57, and 19; amortized cost 472, 54, and 18; and fair value 411, 47, and 16. The filing's investment-status table reports one-stop Non-accrual (3) at table 90 row 9 with principal 577, amortized cost 544, and fair value 474, exactly matching those three source rows. The flag for three non-accrual positions is therefore source-grounded.
